correctness.rationale: The complete Barahona--Mahjoub/Ohsugi facets at a vertex, and even-coordinate-flip vertex transitivity, classify every face in the infinite family; all faces of dimension >=2 have saturated unimodular normal cones. At every edge the n primitive rays in dimension n-1 obey exactly one circuit; the dual semigroup is Z plus \(2\times(n-2)\) nonnegative row/column marginals, yielding the rank-one determinantal chart. All singular orbits and incidence follow from toric orbit-cone correspondence; Segre degree yields multiplicity n-2. The standalone exact rational and integer verifier enumerates n=4,5,6,7 and returns VERIFY_OK, as corroboration only. The theorem is proven uniformly without assuming finite tests extend to infinite n.

value.rationale: The cut toric variety of an elementary cycle is a canonical, long-studied object whose global smoothness and Gorenstein status were known. The exact exponentially growing singular-curve configuration and fixed-point incidence, uniform explicit determinantal transverse germs, and boundary between conifold and non-Q-Gorenstein local geometry are substantive structural information absent from the directly inspected graph-wide criteria. The result is a natural complete classification across all \(n\ge4\), not an arbitrary numerical slice or a routine restatement.
